_comment: Historical skill-room classifications only. This file is not a live skill registry, scaffolding requirement, workflow-handoff contract, or deletion authority. Entries describe legacy corpus that may be considered by a retention planner. Online inspection and planning use the authenticated supervised HTTP hub; apply requires a separately reviewed, immutable, content-hash-bound retention manifest and operation journal. Unknown or unreviewed data is kept. Setup and uninstall preserve all caller-owned data.
